messages:
incident-bot: [AUTO-PAGE] high error-rate alert -> gateway.5xx_rate > 1200 rps (5m avg) in us-west1. Signal fanout detected across edge nodes, 502/504 increase. Pager: PD-87231
pagerduty-bot: Pager triggered -> PD-87231. Escalation policy: inference-prod -> oncall_april (primary)
april: acked and taking it. starting investigation. any initial customer reports? :rotating_light:
leo: seeing 502s at gateway-proxy-3-7 and gw-proxy-3-9. keepalive errors, conn reset. tailing logs now.
maria: metrics: upstream latency jumps ~200ms before 5xx spike. circuit-breaker tripped on several pools. linking dashboard: https://redwood/internal/alerts/PD-87231
april: good context. @leo @maria, can you check if kvcache warmups or model pool OOMs correlate? run k8s describe on gateway pods.
leo: running: kubectl -n prod logs gateway-proxy-3-7 --since=10m | grep -i "keepalive\|reset". snippet:
```
ERROR keepalive: write tcp 10.12.3.45:443: write: connection reset by peer
WARN upstream: handler timeout=30.2s
```
maria: checking model-serving: model-pool-a reported high queue latency but no OOMs. qps doubled over baseline due to retry storms from clients.
ops_lead: tagging for potential mitigation: try temporary 2x autoscale on gateway and enable fallback to model-quantized variant for low-priority tenants.
april: scaling gateways now: bumping deployment replicas + rolling restart on proxies to drain bad conns. executing: kubectl scale deploy gateway-proxy --replicas=8 -n prod
sre_rotation: note: PD-87231 has customer-impact flag set. customer-ops please confirm any external reports.
customer-ops: getting inbound chats. two enterprise tenants reported intermittent 502s between 21:12-21:18 UTC. CS has opened tickets, pushing status to them.
april: temporary mitigation: enabling per-route circuit breakers back to defaults and disabling new connections from edge region us-west1. sending traffic to us-east1 for critical routes.
leo: applied iptables conntrack flush on affected nodes, restarted proxies. early signals: 5xx rate dropping from 1.5k -> 400 in last 3m.
maria: KV cache warmup spike observed; cache misses high at start of spike which amplified backend load. suggest adding sticky cache priming in follow-up.
ops_lead: holding scaling for 5 more mins to verify stability. prepare rollback plan if 5xx resurges.
april: PD ack timeout extended. If stable, I'll handoff to leo for longer-term triage. current status: degraded but recovering. ETA for normal: 30m.
customer-ops: notified affected customers: update posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-87231
sre_rotation: adding runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/gateway-502
leo: taking over follow-up. will run deeper heap/connection tracing and correlate with CDN keepalive settings. oncall handoff to leo in 10m.
april: thanks team. final note: please capture any mitigation commands for postmortem. adding react :thumbsup:
incident-bot: [RESOLVE] Alert PD-87231 auto-closed after 45m with 5xx back to baseline (<50 rps). Incident flagged for postmortem.
ops_lead: assigning postmortem owner: @leo. tagging postmortem docs and timeline.
leo: starting timeline draft now. will include signal fanout, cache priming, and autoscale decisions. ping me if you observed any anomalies.
customer-ops: keeping customers updated; no unresolved escalations.
(april reacts with :white_check_mark:)
